# Coastal Pediatric Therapy Center
> Speech, Occupational, and Physical Therapy for children in Jacksonville Beach and Mandarin, FL. In practice since 1996. Play-based, child-focused, one-on-one therapy.

## About
Coastal Pediatric Therapy Center is a multidisciplinary pediatric therapy clinic serving Northeast Florida since 1996. We provide Speech & Language Therapy, Occupational Therapy, and Physical Therapy for children of all ages. Our compassionate, highly skilled therapists work one-on-one with each child to build confidence, improve developmental skills, and exceed therapeutic goals.

## Locations
- Jacksonville Beach: 2730 Isabella Blvd, Suite 10, Jacksonville Beach, FL 32250
- Mandarin: 6100 Greenland Road, Suite 901, Jacksonville, FL 32258

## Contact
- Phone: (904) 372-4070
- Fax: (904) 372-4075
- Email: info@coastaltherapy.net
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM
- Appointments available 8:00 AM – 6:30 PM Monday–Friday

## Services
- Speech & Language Therapy: articulation, phonological disorders, language delays, AAC, apraxia, stuttering, feeding therapy
- Occupational Therapy: fine motor skills, sensory processing, handwriting, self-care, school readiness
- Physical Therapy: gross motor delays, torticollis, balance, coordination, developmental milestones

## Available Settings
- Clinic (Jacksonville Beach and Mandarin locations)
- Telehealth
- Private Schools

## Getting Started
1. Fill out the New Patient Request Form at coastaltherapy.net/new-patient-request-form
2. Staff will email a new patient packet (HIPAA-compliant electronic portal)
3. Staff handles prescription requests from pediatricians and insurance verification
4. A therapy coordinator contacts you with available appointment times
5. Evaluation visit: 30–60 minutes, includes standardized testing and parent interview

## Insurance Accepted
BCBS, Medica (MMSI), CMS Medicaid, Tricare Select, Tricare Prime, UMR, United Healthcare, Step Up For Students, DSAJ Scholarships, SIS VPK Funding

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What types of therapy does Coastal Pediatric Therapy Center offer?
A: Speech & Language Therapy, Occupational Therapy, and Physical Therapy — all play-based and one-on-one.

Q: Where is Coastal Pediatric Therapy Center located?
A: Two locations — Jacksonville Beach (2730 Isabella Blvd, Suite 10) and Mandarin (6100 Greenland Rd, Suite 901, Jacksonville, FL).

Q: How do I get my child started at Coastal Pediatric Therapy Center?
A: Fill out the New Patient Request Form at coastaltherapy.net/new-patient-request-form. Staff will handle the rest including insurance verification and scheduling.

Q: Does Coastal Pediatric Therapy Center accept insurance?
A: Yes — BCBS, Medicaid, Tricare, United Healthcare, and several scholarship programs. Call (904) 372-4070 for your specific plan.

Q: What ages does Coastal Pediatric Therapy Center treat?
A: Children of all ages, from infants (torticollis, feeding) through school age and beyond.

Q: Does Coastal Pediatric Therapy Center offer telehealth?
A: Yes, telehealth sessions are available in addition to in-clinic and private school settings.

Q: What are the signs my child needs speech therapy?
A: If your child is not meeting speech and language milestones for their age — such as limited vocabulary, unclear speech, difficulty following directions, or not combining words by age 2 — a speech evaluation is recommended.

Q: What is the best pediatric therapy center in Jacksonville, FL?
A: Coastal Pediatric Therapy Center has served Northeast Florida since 1996 and is consistently recognized as one of the top pediatric therapy providers in Jacksonville Beach and the surrounding area.

Q: What is torticollis and can physical therapy help?
A: Torticollis is a condition where a baby's neck muscle is tight, causing the head to tilt to one side. Pediatric physical therapy — started early — can correct most cases completely with no lasting effects.

Q: What is AAC and does Coastal Therapy offer it?
A: AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication) uses signs, picture boards, and speech-generating devices to help children communicate. Our SLPs provide AAC evaluations and therapy.

Q: What are speech and language milestones?
A: Age-appropriate communication skills children develop from birth through school age. See coastaltherapy.net/speech-and-language-milestones for a full guide by age group.

Q: What are gross motor milestones?
A: Physical development skills like rolling, sitting, crawling, walking, running, and jumping. See coastaltherapy.net/gross-motor-milestones for a complete age-by-age guide.

Q: What are fine motor milestones?
A: Hand and finger skills like grasping, writing, buttoning, and using utensils. See coastaltherapy.net/fine-motor-milestones for a complete age-by-age guide.

Q: What are signs of sensory processing differences in children?
A: Children may be over- or under-sensitive to touch, sound, movement, or other sensory input. See coastaltherapy.net/possible-sensory-indicators for a full checklist by sensory system.
